retrievalProfile.description: A centered, low-angle portrait of a man in a white shirt seated in a moody, plum-colored room with ornate gold accents and large-scale script typography overlaying the foreground.
triggerTerms: man writing at a table portrait

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure in a crisp white shirt sits hunched over a small table, writing. The background is a deep plum-purple wall adorned with an ornate gold mirror and framed art. The foreground features large, elegant white script text that spans the width of the composition, partially overlapping the furniture.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the bright white shirt and the deep plum/black background
Symmetrical balance created by the central figure and flanking stools
Textural contrast between velvet upholstery, gold metal, and smooth wall paint
Foreground typography acting as a visual veil over the lower third of the image
coreInvariants: Ornate gold-framed oval mirror on the left
Central figure in a white button-down shirt looking downward

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the middle third of the frame vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white shirt of the subject serves as the primary focal point against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the white shirt, moves down to the hands and books on the table, then follows the large script text across the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the plum wall in the upper half and the dark shadows under the table.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold (mirror frame, table legs, stool bases)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Deep, saturated wall color with high-value white highlights and low-value shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant, fluid cursive script with varying stroke weights
letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with high-contrast thick and thin strokes
Open loops in characters like 'y' and 'f'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' features a dramatic, elongated crossbar that extends into a flourish
The 'y' has a wide, sweeping tail that underlines subsequent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative, expressive script with a minimal, geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory label in bottom left corner
Ornate gold mirror as a secondary framing element

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, handwritten feel of the main title
Provides a clean, modern contrast for the artist name

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a white shirt sitting at a small table in a room with plum-purple walls, an ornate gold mirror, and velvet furniture. The lighting should be moody and focused on the subject.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, white, elegant hand-drawn script across the lower third of the image. Add a small, clean sans-serif name in all caps, right-aligned beneath the script.

verificationChecks: Is the script fluid and expressive?
Is the plum wall color deep and saturated?
Does the white shirt pop against the background?
Is the text legible despite the overlap?

adjustableVariables: Wall color (can shift to deep navy or emerald)
Subject's pose (can be looking at camera or writing)
mustRedesign: Avoid using generic brush scripts; ensure the lettering feels custom and elegant
Do not use flat, bright lighting; maintain the moody atmosphere

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of typography and image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the gold mirror looks metallic and ornate
Ensure the script text has a 'hand-written' quality
Verify the white shirt is not overexposed
Confirm the plum wall has a slight matte texture
Check that the parental advisory label is correctly placed if requested
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject in white + deep jewel-tone wall + ornate gold accents + large foreground script overlay.
